brief:
Settlers established a new settlement outpost affiliated with the Homesh religious institute on land in Yasid village north of Nablus, Shehab Wire reported. The outpost sits in Area A, classified under Palestinian control, and threatens approximately 15,000 dunams of agricultural land in the region.

The new settlement is accompanied by assaults and restrictions preventing farmers from accessing their property, according to the report. The outpost represents an expansion of Homesh-affiliated settlement activity in the northern West Bank.
